profile_text.body:
Saltillo develops TouchChat, an iOS app for augmentative and alternative communication. The company's site describes the app as a dynamic communication solution for people who have difficulty speaking with their natural voice, offering customizable features and a range of vocabularies, languages, and voices. It highlights head tracking, which uses facial recognition on newer iPad Pro and iPhone models to track head and face movements, along with built-in switch scanning and touch access. The site also notes iOS Split View, which lets users run two apps side by side, and points to three different TouchChat apps available on the App Store.

The site's notices mention scheduled maintenance on its websites and that phone numbers starting with "800" were down, directing callers to local numbers starting in "330" (main 330-262-1984, service 330-262-0845).

TouchChat is tracked as an Education and Research AI product, with word prediction and use as an AAC app for students with communication needs and speech-language pathologists. Pricing listed for TouchChat HD is $149.99+ on the App Store, drawn from a 2022 state AT program list, so the figure may be out of date. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded.
